name: hostel-waste-management-root
description: Smart Hostel Food Waste Prediction & Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "green,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "green,cyan" "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
